rca_of_issue: Root cause for launch blocker: gallery.tsx View action is intentionally stubbed with Alert('Coming Soon') and does not route blueprint data back to /canvas. Repro: login -> create/save blueprint -> home -> My Blueprints -> tap View. Mitigation: navigate to /canvas with serialized elements/name or fetch blueprint by id then hydrate canvas state.
